description: Recent engagement feed across ALL your sent mail — the 'who just opened/clicked my mail' notifications stream (opens, clicks, forwards, reader print/copy signals), newest first, each with the email subject + recipient. Poll: pass the returned `cursor` back as `since` to get only new activity. Owner-scoped.

since.description: ISO-8601 cursor — return only events newer than this. Pass the previous response's `cursor` to poll for new activity.

name: mAYL_notify
